warnings: Every footing is tagged 'F<n>, C2' — pile cap F1 (1 pile) or F2 (2 piles, S-06) with the ground stub column C2 on it. 15 footings: F1 x11, F2 x4.

Row A and row C footings at the west side sit on the printed grid 1' (0.20 right of grid 1); the row F footing sits on grid 1 itself (measured against the 0.20 tick, S-02 agrees: column C1 drawn on grid 1 there).
The row-G footing near grid 2 sits on 2' (2.95), the 0.25 tick printed on S-02 — S-01 itself prints no tick there, position read from S-02.
F2 caps (0.90 x 0.36) are drawn with the long side along x at all four positions.
C2 (stub column) has no section of its own anywhere in the set; S-06 only draws it inside the footing detail.
